description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-born specialty coffee chain operating since 1992, with this location inside Kelowna's Innovation Centre. The café serves handcrafted espresso drinks, nitro coffee, whole-leaf teas, protein shakes, and a broad food menu ranging from breakfast wraps to baked goods and desserts. As a locally franchised outlet in a downtown business hub, it makes a convenient mid-ride stop for cyclists passing through central Kelowna.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: address (104 – 460 Doyle Avenue, Kelowna BC V1Y 2A2), phone (250-712-2227), and store name all match. OSM tag takeaway=yes is supported by the website's online ordering feature. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill appears anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café in downtown Kelowna confirmed by matching website content. A legitimate rest stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM name field is 'Blenz Coffee' while the branch tag and website page title both use 'Blenz in Innovation Centre'; this is a normal chain/branch naming convention and not a concern.

wow_evidence: BC-born specialty coffee chain operating since 1992… inside Kelowna's Innovation Centre
